description: codebase-kg advisory hook: a PostToolUse nudge on Edit/Write/MultiEdit that reminds you to run /codebase-kg:refresh when source files under the repo's root change without the KNOWLEDGE_GRAPH.md being touched. Never blocks, never edits. Honors .claude/codebase-kg.local.md (post_edit_nudge, nudge_every, root, kg_path); no-ops when the repo has no KG.
